body:
FORGE FINALE -- session 9: CONFIRMED, needs your call

Built you a tracker with tick boxes (sent as a local file -- open it directly, FORGE_FINALE_TRACKER.html in the tungsten folder). It'll update every session from here.

The thing flagged last update is real, not theoretical. Confirmed: every second the market is open, a completely separate part of the code can quietly replace the live trading score with its own calculation -- and that replaced score is the exact number the real buy/sell decision reads. Zero log trace when it happens (the code's own comment says "handled silently").

I did NOT touch it. This is a decision about whether TUNGSTEN should even have this fast reaction path, not a bug I can just fix -- same category as the scoring question from a few days ago that you had to weigh in on. Whenever you get a chance, let me know how you want to handle it (disable it, make it use the same formula as the main scorer, or leave it and just make it log what it's doing) -- everything else keeps moving in the meantime.

Score: 13/45 held steady, but this session was about surfacing something important, not adding a checkmark.
